notes.title: New Game +, Screen Shot Mode are Coming! Historical 30% off！
notes.content:
"New Game +" and New Difficulty Level

We prepared a "New Game +" mode for those players who are still longing for more after completing the first playthrough. Players can inherit weapons, chips, credits, skill points, and talents. With full proficient Ann, saving the world again!

Meanwhile, the "New Game +“ mode also allows players to adjust the difficulty to a higher level of "Hell". For those players who would like to play relaxedly, we have also prepared "Easy Mode" as well. 。

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469021/09abf5071d2f4620f28e739f18c0253a9e2bd6f3.png

Added English and Japanese multi-ending voice-over
Fixed part of the cutscene errors
Fixed some language text display errors
Optimized the AI behavior tree of some enemy soldiers
Optimized the armor value of some elites

notes.title: [1.04] New ending online, new costumes and easy mode added
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you all for your recent support and encouragement! During this time, we've received a lot of suggestions and comments from players. All of them are really helpful!

After more than a month of struggle, we have improved the game's experience, difficulty balance and added new costumes, while also adding a more complete ending. Players who have already finished the game can also experience the new ending through the cover of the "On the Eve of an Ending".

Meanwhile, due to time constraints, the translation of some languages and English/Japanese voiceover

notes.title: Recent update plan
notes.content:
Dear mutationites! After receiving all kinds of feedback, in the next period, our update will be mainly divided into three parts bug fixes, battle experience optimization, language corrections, and adding some more plot-related content.

1. first, we will continue to fix all kinds of bugs that affect the game experience, including text errors, camera errors, collision errors, etc., which will be a more frequent process. This might be a daily update. 

2. We will also "smoothen" the combat-related experience step by step by optimizing the control of the main character, optimizing the power and special effects of weapons, optimizing the behavior of the enemy, etc., this part of the update will also be an ongoing process. 

3. A part of the quest and side quests will be added to optimize the current plot which is controversial. This part of the update will be released in the near future. This will be focusing on the end game part and won't affect the progress made by players who already finished the game

4. At the same time, we will also occasionally update some other content like clothing. We hope you will enjoy it. 

Finally, thank you very much for your feedback during this time, we still have a lot of work to do but will keep our best to take your feedback into consideration and to make ANNO: Mutationem better. 
We will try our best! Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Available during Limited Time!
notes.content:
Hi, mutationites! 

During August 25th - September 12th, Demo is back for various activities!
For those who have missed the last Demo, join us this time!

 Check it & let us know what you think!

[ The demo will be the same contents as last time, but we're using all your feedback for the final version of the game! ]

- About the Demo - 

The Demo features some gameplay where you can explore one of the many cities in the game, meet and interact with the NPCs, experience the thrill of battles, and get a glimpse of the story and mysteries (as well as some easter eggs, check them 😊). 
Join our protagonist Ann and Ayane to explore this 2D – 3D cyberpunk world, unraveling the story behind it!
